rawContent: Today, AFT leaders and members across the country are standing in solidarity with our union family in Minneapolis. HAPPENING SOON: @rweingarten, @Lily_NEA, @BeckyPringle, and @DeniseSpecht join @MFT59 for a telephone town hall about the murder of #GeorgeFloyd and the fight for racial justice. Follow this thread for more. #BlackLivesMatter

.@MFT59 president Greta Callahan: As a union, we must stand up for our values and make them known to the world. We do not condone white supremacy, racism, or fascism. We as a union must be 100% committed to this work in order for members & students to feel safe. #BlackLivesMatter

.@MFT59 ESP President Shaun Laden: We are working with community organizations and other union leaders to use our power to hold leaders accountable, and are working to address whiteness and biases within our own union. #BlackLivesMatter
.@EducationMN President @DeniseSpecht: There is no place in the Minnesota labor movement for Bob Kroll, and the attitudes that he has cultivated. #BlackLivesMatter

.@BeckyPringle: No one expected that we would be called to lead in a moment like this. But this is the moment we've been called to. @MFT59 has stepped up to the challenge, done the work, and challenged the racism in our community. I am so proud. #BlackLivesMatter

.@rweingarten: I have hope that we can make change. Because of our students, because of you, because of video, and because you elected different people in 2018 including an attorney general & governor & two mayors who are willing  to uproot the status quo. #BlackLivesMatter

.@rweingarten: I remember right before our convention in Minneapolis, when Philandro Castile was killed. There was a sense we could change things if some people were electedm if the Minneapolis police changed. That didn't happen. #BlackLivesMatter

.@rweingarten: But even with #COVID19, our communities are standing up to say never again truly means never again. Hundreds of thousands of peaceful protestors saying murder is murder, made worse by police officers that are supposed to be protecting. #BlackLivesMatter

.@rweingarten: No doubt if George Floyd was white, he'd still be alive right now. And that's something that we as educators and communities and we as a country need to grapple with, particularly those of us who are white. #BlackLivesMatter

.@rweingarten: It's up to us as a community to take this on. You are showing that. With the four police who were arrested, charged with murder, that's the first step. That wouldn't have happened without the protests. But that's only the first step. #BlackLivesMatter

.@rweingarten: We as educators, nurses, ESPs & others, we've talked about this stuff for a long time. Our job is to do everything we can - not just not be silent - to fundamentally change this, to use this as a tipping point to make our nation more equitable. #BlackLivesMatter

.@rweingarten: Thank all of you for doing this righteous work, fighting through justice. That's who we are, and must be now. Inequality, healthcare inequality, economic inequality, and judicial inequality for minorities need to be addressed. #BlackLivesMatter

.@rweingarten: @mft59 started a petition, donated to a food bank, & addressed policing in schools. You've taken important, righteous steps in George Floyd's memory, Breonna Taylor's memory, Auhmad's Aubrey's memory,  Eric Garner's memory, Abner Louima's memory. #BlackLivesMatter

.@rweingarten: We're in the middle of 3 crises: a health crisis, an economic crisis, & a justice crisis. We must take this issue on and not let it go away like it did after Philandro Castile, Eric Garner, Trayvon Martin, & Abner Louima died. That's our work. #BlackLivesMatter

“It sends a message: ‘Hey, my teachers are down there advocating for my life.’ All of our students pretty much in [Detroit Public Schools Community District]are students of color. We need to be visible.” #BlackLivesMatter  https://t.co/zuYJhVnY9k

Racial equity is the great unfinished work of this country. Our students give us reason to hope. If you’re an educator, add your name to this letter from America's educators to our students in support of #BlackLivesMatter: https://t.co/vm7U97tPsa

.@rweingarten: I'm glad there are protests across the country against this systemic racism. These protests, plus elections, are what it's going to take to change the country. It's a fight we as a union have been involved in since before Brown v Board. #AFTvotes #BlackLivesMatter

.@rweingarten: I don't think you have to be a liberal or a leftist or a Democrat to think how bad all of this is. Downplaying #COVID19, teargassing protestors, now holding a rally in Tulsa on Juneteenth - what does he not get? #BlackLivesMatter #AFTvotes

.@rweingarten: It shouldn't take one more Black American like Terrence Martin to tell us how it feels over and over again. We need activism because we have a President throwing gasoline on the fire and making every crisis worse. #BlackLivesMatter

.@rweingarten: We have to figure out in this unprecedented time how to get ourselves out to vote AND get our friends, neighbors, parents, and children out to vote. How we're going to change this country once and for all, for all people. #AFTvotes #BlackLivesMatter

.@rweingarten: There is hope now because of all that has happened. White allies must do right for our Black and Brown brothers and sisters. We're physically apart, but we can be more socially connected than ever & change the US once and for all. #AFTvotes #BlackLivesMatter

"This initiative is especially important right now, as each of us feel the urgency to make our voices heard this fall after the continued silence from our leaders on the many black people being killed by police."  https://t.co/s0nb9nfGVN #AFTvotes #BlackLivesMatter

Great news! The #JusticeInPolicingAct is important legislation. #BlackLivesMatter   https://t.co/D0kuZ3Ou4W
.@rweingarten and @TheRevAl are discussing our recent resolution on confronting racism. You can read the whole resolution here. #BlackLivesMatter   https://t.co/Al99ifYtA8

AFT President @rweingarten was on @PoliticsNation with @TheRevAl on Sunday discussing policing in schools, racism, and our commitment to making schools safe and welcoming for every student and educator. #BlackLivesMatter #1u https://t.co/afXViBOl3t

Listen, learn and try to understand the generational fatigue Black people face from years of bullying, low expectations, under-resourced schools, fear and worse. Read one education expert's personal story #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/3KbzbMQd6g

.@rweingarten: It takes activism as well as elections. When people don't feel empowered, they give up. What we saw with #Red4Ed & #FundOurFuture, in #BlackLivesMatter, people see themselves in these movements & see the movements as important. #DemocracyForAll

“We need to address the structural issues so that everyone is treated fairly, and we need to invest in efforts to improve access to quality healthcare by expanding it to all." #BlackLivesMatter 

Read & RT: https://t.co/5j32Oo8odh

I have to take a moment to honror the life and courage of Congressman John Lewis. I was so hurt to hear that he was gone, but I am glad that he lived to witness the moment in this nation to come together and say #BlackLivesMatter. -@LorrettaJohnson #AFT20

For this morning's #BlackLivesMatter panel, President Weingarten is joined by @BerniceKing, @JamaalBowmanNY, @NAACPmpls President @LeslieERedmond , and @saribethrose, a history teacher and @UFT member.

You don't want to miss this: https://t.co/Ey7sslbVAo

Q: What gives you hope?

@BerniceKing: There has been a generation of young voices that will not let us go back to business as usual, to not let us ignore that #BlackLivesMatter. For the past eight years they have been consistent with that message. #AFT20
Continuing the conversation on racism #BlackLivesMatter #AFT20 @BerniceKing @JamaalBowmanNY @saribethrose @LeslieERedmond https://t.co/aYOsOv0sJb

.@rweingarten: We shouldn't have had to wait for fires on the West Coast or fierce hurricanes in the Gulf Coast and the Caribbean for climate change to become an issue. #ClimateCrisis #AFTvotes
.@rweingarten: This isn't a crisis that can be solved by raking the leaves or increasing our use of fossil fuels or coal. President Trump doesn't care about the #ClimateCrisis. #AFTvotes

.@rweingarten: Sustainability of the earth is absolutely imperative, and we need to connect the dots for people why the #GreenNewDeal and attention to our environment is so important. We did the damage to the earth. Now it's up to us to fix it. #ClimateCrisis #AFTvotes

.@rweingarten: There is no zero sum solution here. There's a lot of opportunity for green union jobs and sustainability here. This is our chance to make this the New Deal for our century.  #GreenNewDeal #ClimateCrisis #AFTvotes

.@rweingarten: It shouldn't have taken #COVID19 to make our schools safe and sustainable. We need to make sure they have the ventilation so students can breathe and the technology to prepare them for the future. #ClimateCrisis #AFTvotes

.@hmcghee, @ColorOfChange: This is about more than just the election, which is already underway. This election is a culminating moment of the last 4 years in the US, where we've seen the act of citizenship go on steroids. #ClimateCrisis #AFTvotes https://t.co/fnZZNAEfHD

.@hmcghee: The science is showing a clear link between pollution & fertility. 1 in every 5 premature babies is linked to air pollution. These issues are connected to the fundamental ways that we live, and the air we breathe. #ClimateCrisis #AFTvotes

.@hmcghee: We know the facts about the #ClimateCrisis. We know the science. We know 95% of scientists agree that climate change is real. You don't believe that it's raining or not raining, it's just raining. #AFTvotes

.@hmcghee: The #GreenNewDeal is our vision to create millions of high wage jobs with a vision of transitioning our economy towards 100% clean energy and net zero emissions by 2050. That's all there is. It's our New Deal. #ClimateCrisis

.@SenMarkey: Donald Trump is the #DenierInChief. Whether it's about #COVID19 or the #ClimateCrisis, he doesn't believe the science. We're at a turning point here as a country. #AFTvotes https://t.co/W8QxeMZUVW

.@SenMarkey: In 2016, there was not a single question asked in the Presidential debates about climate change. The #GreenNewDeal brought the #ClimateCrisis into the conversation - and that's one of the goals, to lift people's gaze to the possibilities! #AFTvotes

.@SenMarkey: Black and Brown families have always breathed different air than white families. They have higher rates of asthma & often live closer to pollution. Because of this, these communities are more susceptible to #COVID19. Everything is linked. #ClimateCrisis #GreenNewDeal

.@SenMarkey: Young people are leading us on climate. We should listen to young people. We should follow the young people. They are angry that they've been left with this problem that will afflict them for their whole lives unless we act. #ClimateCrisis #AFTvotes
.@SenMarkey: If Donald Trump gets re-elected, it's a death sentence for the planet because he will thwart the action necessary to save Earth. We can change that. #ClimateCrisis #AFTvotes

.@Amorphousslob, @sunrisemvmt: I came up through 2 of the worst economic downturns in the history, and I watched Katrina rip through Louisiana. It inspired me to start building the movement for environmental justice. #ClimateCrisis #AFTvotes https://t.co/DToexnGxw6

.@Amorphousslob: All 50 states are under a federal disaster declaration, and it's not just because of #COVID19. The West is still on fire. The Southeast has been rocked by so many storms they ran out of letters to name them. #ClimateCrisis #AFTvotes

.@Amorphousslob: We've seen the pictures of orange skies in the West, but what's talked about less is the first responders that have to respond to them without #ppe. Only the wealthy can afford to flee. Black and Brown communities got hit hard. #ClimateCrisis #AFTvotes
.@Amorphousslob: The era of incrementalism needs to end. Our leaders need to take bold steps and writing sweeping policy like the #GreenNewDeal and the #THRIVEAgenda. #ClimateCrisis #AFTvotes

.@Amorphousslob: We're doing the work that is necessary to build a multiracial movement of working people that is required to build the future we want to see. That's why it's so important we defeat Donald Trump this election. #ClimateCrisis #AFTvotes

.@Amorphousslob: I think about James Baldwin's quote a lot, “Not everything that is faced can be changed. But nothing can be changed until it is faced." The movement building we've seen this year demonstrates the willingness to fight for our future. #ClimateCrisis #AFTvotes

.@rweingarten: Our activism cannot stop on November 4th. It must continue going forward as well, and we must continue to work together.

If you think the #ClimateCrisis is important, get involved. Visit https://t.co/mSHraSzUoY for more. #AFTvotes

Q, Todd Wolfson, @RUAAUP: How can we work with union siblings in the energy sector to make this transition to green energy?

@SenMarkey: We must do so in a way that takes care of all workers. We can invest in programs to train these workers. #ClimateCrisis #GreenNewDeal

.@Amorphousslob: This is a transition that is already happening. The market is shifting towards renewable energy, and if we want workers to be protected then there has to be intentional planning and investment in those workers. #ClimateCrisis #GreenNewDeal

Q: What can we do to move towards a safer climate?

@hmcghee: Create a blue wave in November. The environment has become a partisan issue - it's a shame, but it's true. We need Democrats up and down the ballot to tackle the #ClimateCrisis. It's that simple. #AFTvotes

Q: How can we get students involved in the planning for a cleaner earth?

@Amorphousslob: I personally feel that art projects (any form of art) to draw attention to it. Young people are undersold on their ability to participate in politics. #ClimateCrisis #AFTvotes
.@SenMarkey: We need to make sure that students are learning about climate change and sustainability, but we need to do more than that. #ClimateCrisis #AFTvotes

Q, @rweingarten:  How do we make schools part & parcel of the #GreenNewDeal?

@SenMarkey: We're going to invest in clean infrastructure for schools, and invest in programs to train students on green new energy. #ClimateCrisis #GreenNewDeal #AFTvotes
We need a president who understands that #BlackLivesMatter. We need a president who cares about making sure everyone can get the healthcare they need. - @rweingarten #AFTvotes
Biden is poised to turn us around when it comes to fighting the #ClimateCrisis. He's ready to take it seriously and put us on a path to saving the planet. https://t.co/LxSmgBlLis
"We know that #BlackLivesMatter, but that means that Black lives need to matter every single day in every thing that we do, including with the tech companies and with the unions." @rweingarten
